scope: Strict adoption-program draft queue, explicit customer-value benchmark projection, and energy CLI date preflight

invariants: status is draft and draft page contains exactly the migration-520 projection
consent policy fields are all null or all present and valid
page echoes and binds location, limit, and offset; IDs are unique
items follow created_at DESC, program_id ASC
unrequestable lookahead beyond offset 10000 is represented by offset_limited without a next_offset
malformed service results return sanitized no-store errors
console validates page metadata and reports when remaining drafts exceed the offset cap

preserved_behavior: filters remain strategy_plan_id, benchmark_type, measure_name, and submitted/verified/published status
ordering remains observed_at DESC, subject_type, subject_name
UUID cleanup and row payload remain unchanged

invariants: invalid supplied dates fail via parser.error before cli.run can acquire PostgreSQL
valid values use the existing date.fromisoformat behavior and handler conversion
omitted and empty optional date values keep their existing fallback behavior

verification.energy_date_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_cli_energy_monitoring_scope.py -k 'date_arguments or valid_iso_date or missing_or_empty_date' -q
